title: 244 Winston Ln – 30A Beach Properties
description_expanded:
30-A Beach Properties presents, 244 Winston ln. This charming beach cottage is located 2nd row from the Gulf, in "The Bluffs, at Inlet Beach". Located just 400 Feet from the edge of Rosemary Beach, The Bluffs is a private community, with 335' of reserved beach frontage, a Gulf front community pool, and multiple gated beach access points.

244 Winston ln features 4 storys, 3 levels of living space, plus the first floor foyer, a carport with 2 spaces, and 2 uncovered reserved spaces.

2nd Floor: Open Living, Kitchen, Dining. 2 Balconies with views of the gulf, breakfast bar with seating for four, and a half bathroom.

3rd Floor: Bedroom #1, Queen Bedroom with ensuite bathroom and private balcony.

Bedroom #2, Bunk Room, 2 Twin Top Bunks, 2 Full Bottom Bunks, and ensuite bathroom.

Laundry Room.

4th Floor: Master Suite takes up this entire floor. Featuring a private balcony with sunset gulf views, large bathroom with soaking tub and dual vanities, and a private coffee bar, with sink, and

refrigerator.(Note: 4th Floor requires access via spiral staircase)

All linens, including comforters are professionally laundered for each new reservation!

Features:

335' of Private Beach

Gated, Gulf Front Community Pool

A 4 Minute Bike Ride to Shopping and Dining in both Rosemary Beach, and 30-Avenue.

4th Floor Master Suite with large soaking tub, Coffee station with refrigerator, and Private Balcony with Sunset Facing Gulf Views.

3 Total Bedrooms, 3.5 Total Bathrooms, Sleeps 8

All New Linens for 2025

4 Dedicated Parking spots; 2 Covered, 2 Uncovered.

Access to Discounted Bicycle pricing through 30-A Beach Properties
